notes: Hosted table: six seats, and the host taps the names to number the turn order
EMPEROR, a 3v3 table mode: pawns and emperors seated by that order, with the attack rule
UNDO END TURN at the top of the game menu (hold the turn chip) takes back a turn passed by mistake
Each device picks FULL or BASIC for a table; BASIC keeps the turn chip at the foot
RESULTS names the winner and plays the fanfare on their device; the LED ring runs full on your turn, a quarter on others'
HOW TO PLAY has a chapter for every game on the wheel, and the (?) opens it
ARCADE: Bricks -- breakout on the round glass, a new wall every level, powerups, three lives
Quieter steppers, a turn label that fits, smaller rim clocks, toasts gone in two seconds, Game on! two seconds, a guild tap applies and closes, no low-life blink in a race
